# THUMBNAIL.md — River Flow Naturescapes (test fixture)

Thumbnail grammar for this channel. Language and boundaries, never a template.

## Visual grammar

A single strong water subject read at a glance: the river, the fall or the stream fills the frame and the eye lands on the water first.

## Typography

Little or no type. When research supports a word or two, a light editorial serif in off-white, small, never a headline.

## Text

Prefer no text. Text is the exception and needs a reason recorded in the publish log.

## Colour direction

The footage's own greens, blues and stone greys, graded as the film is graded. No saturated overlays, no colour blocks.

## Subject emphasis

Water in motion. A shot the viewer recognises from the film; never an image that is not in the video.

## Composition

Clean, uncluttered, one focal point. Depth from foreground rock or foliage is welcome; clutter is not.

## Acceptable layout families

Full-bleed frame. Full-bleed frame with a small quiet wordmark corner. Nothing else.

## Avoid

Faces. Arrows. Circles. Emoji. Stacked words. Neon. A competitor's crop or colour treatment.
